_note: Voiceover script. `at` = output seconds where the line starts (keep in sync with VO in src/timeline.ts). To use your own voice: record each line as voiceover/founder/<id>.wav (any sample rate, mono or stereo) and run `npm run audio && npm run final`. Lines without a founder file fall back to the synthetic stand-in in voiceover/synthetic/.

lines.text: AI agents can execute commands. Who controls what they're allowed to do?
Here, Claude Code tries to read a decoy file in dot S S H. The TEND hook denies it before it runs.
The block is logged, with the rule that stopped it.
TEND installs as Claude Code hooks, so every tool call is checked. The rules live in TEND. Everyday commands just run, and get recorded.
Deleting a file needs approval. Claude Code waits, and the exact request shows up in TEND.
Allowed, blocked, approved. Every decision is recorded, with its reason.
